paper_title: Constraining dark photon parameters based on the very high energy observations of blazars
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter epsilon (dimensionless), as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper derives new 95% C.L. exclusion on dark photon kinetic mixing from photon-dark photon scattering (gamma + gamma' -> e+e-) attenuation of VHE gamma rays from blazars Mrk 421 and Mrk 501 (HEGRA data), dominated by the DM spike around the host-galaxy SMBH. The exclusion curves are only shown in Fig. 4 (mass range 1e-2 to 1e4 eV, benchmark ECPL spectral model, Dominguez EBL, Rem=4Rs); no numerical table is provided. The only explicit numbers in text are epsilon ~ 1e-7 over mD ~ 0.03-1 eV, encoded here as a two-point flat bound over that validity range. Actual curve is mass-dependent and weaker outside this range. The bound assumes dark photons constitute all DM (spike + NFW host halo + IGM + Milky Way with local rho=0.4 GeV/cm^3), but this is an astrophysical absorption bound, not a haloscope, so dm_density_assumed left null.
